immediate.judge: I will rule on the matter as it currently stands. We move directly to the verdict.

conditional.judge: I will start by proposing a conditional mediation that takes each side's responsibility separately. The studio-apartment visits and late-night calls, the personal-fund withdrawal, and the cancellation of the joint savings will not all be bundled into one matter.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: If it is a conditional mediation, I can accept that. But the facts about the studio-apartment visits and the late-night calls have to be settled clearly first, or the same suspicion just keeps coming back.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: I can accept the conditional terms as well. But please keep my 30-million-won personal-fund withdrawal and my wife's cancellation of the joint savings as two separate matters.

postpone.judge: I will fix only the facts that can be confirmed today and reserve the rest. The responsibility for what was hidden and the responsibility for moving first on a judgment will be looked at separately.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: I can accept reserving a decision. But the studio-apartment visits and the late-night calls at least have to be confirmed today, or all that's left is more guesswork.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: I also think the circumstances need a closer look before any hasty conclusion. But please make it clear that reserving a decision is not the same as being cleared.

fact_first.judge: Before any solution, I will fix the facts. We start with the order of events: the studio-apartment visits and late-night calls, the 30-million-won withdrawal from the personal account, and the cancellation of the joint savings.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: I agree with sorting out the facts first. At least the studio-apartment visits and the late-night calls — please confirm those clearly against the records first.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: If facts come before solutions, I can accept that. But please don't let the studio-apartment visits and late-night calls calcify into a finding of an affair.
